input.summary: Dairy Chiller audit at Ikeja Depot Shop was high confidence (0.95), 100% planogram share, no unknown products. One of six SKUs was stocked out: Peak Evaporated Milk 160g (0 of 3 expected facings). Inventory shows 3 units on hand against a reorder point of 6 - enough for an immediate partial shelf refill but below reorder threshold, so both actions were taken: (1) manager notified via WhatsApp to face up the 3 on-hand units now, and (2) a reorder of 1 case (12 units, ~NGN 5,400) proposed to reach 15 units, covering 3 facings x 3 = 9 units plus the reorder point of 6. The other five SKUs (Peak Powdered 400g, Three Crowns Evaporated 160g, Cowbell Sachet 12g, Dano Cool Cow 400g, Hollandia Yoghurt 1L) are all at expected facings - no action. No telemetry available and no visible equipment damage, so no technician dispatched. No escalation needed.
